subject: [PATCH RFC nfs-utils 6/7] nfsdctl: clear rpcbind entries when the last thread stops

2026-09-10.patch_summary: This patch modifies the nfsdctl command to clear rpcbind entries when the last thread stops. The previous behavior was incorrect, as it relied on a kernel function that is no longer used. The patch fixes this issue by checking if all threads have stopped and clearing the rpcbind entries only then. This ensures that the rpcbind entries do not outlive the server and point to an unused port.
